discovery_assessment.benefit: The include is rooted at the repository src directory, so default Vitest discovery no longer traverses nested .pumarejo or worktree source copies.

findings.observation: Replacing Vitest's default include with src/**/*.test.{ts,tsx} removes the tracked scripts/remove-with-retry.test.mjs file from an ordinary npm test run, even though package.json defines npm test as vitest run and the script test is part of the baseline repository.
findings.impact: The aggregate can become green while three tests covering removeWithRetry, used by scripts/run-tauri-e2e.mjs, are silently skipped. The stale nested copies are excluded, but a legitimate repository test loses coverage.
findings.recommendation: Keep the anchored src include and add the explicit tracked test family, for example scripts/**/*.test.mjs, or use an equally narrow include list that covers every tracked test location. Confirm the aggregate reports the script tests again.
